title: Choose the visual world for Choose Like Buddha
question: The roll assigned the Thangka Drafting Grid. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Thangka Drafting Grid
options.lineage: Tibetan thangka iconometry (thig tshad) and the five-family mandala plan
options.thesis: The five concepts laid out as a mandala's five positions, drawn the way a thangka painter drafts: construction lines first, then mineral pigment.
materials: gold construction line on deep indigo ground
flat mineral-pigment fields (azurite, orpiment, cinnabar, malachite, conch)
options.viewport: Headline and store badges on the left; on the right a square mandala plan whose centre holds today's real item as two honest options, with the four other concepts at the gates.
options.risk: Could tip into New Age colouring-book mandalas if the ornament grows and the draughtsman's restraint slips.

raised.raise: Unpractised positions stay drawn as faint construction lines; absence is designed as carefully as pigment.
Cinnabar means one thing only: the gap between what you'd do and what you did.
All five concept diagrams share one scale and baseline, so leans compare at a glance.
Each concept's tension is drawn as a line between two poles, with distinct at-rest and leaning states.
Small, honest instruments (today's five, day count) as quiet chrome, labelled as a sample.

options.label: Twin Verses Palm-Leaf
options.lineage: Pali palm-leaf manuscripts and the Dhammapada's Yamaka (paired verses)
options.thesis: Each day's choice set as a paired verse on a long palm leaf: what you'd do on one half, what you did on the other.
materials: cinnabar-dyed binding string through two holes
options.viewport: A bundle of long horizontal leaves across the full width; the top leaf is today's pair, and the string holes act as the page's navigation.
options.risk: Familiar: warm manuscript tones land close to the cream-and-serif look many sites in this space already ship.

options.label: Akari Paper Light
options.lineage: Noguchi akari lanterns, washi over bamboo ribs
options.thesis: Five paper lanterns in a dim room, one per concept, glowing when practised.
options.viewport: A dim room with five lanterns at different heights; today's concept is lit, and the headline sits in its glow.
options.case: Fuses well with Zen-leaning practitioners; loses on clarity, because a lantern can't show the would/did gap.
options.risk: Warm ivory plus a vermilion stamp is close to a look often seen in this category.

options.label: Tensegrity Breathing Column
options.thesis: Opposing forces held in balance, a column that seems to breathe.
options.viewport: A force diagram with each concept as a strut between two cords.
options.case: Fuses on tension, but practitioners don't see themselves in engineering diagrams.
options.kept: Tension drawn as distinct at-rest and leaning states.
options.risk: Cold and technical for a contemplative audience.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.thesis: Identity as a room you furnish.
options.viewport: An isometric room decorated with earned badges.
options.case: Fuses poorly: gamified decoration fights a no-score practice.
options.risk: Reads as a game, contradicting 'no scores'.

options.label: Seven-Segment Display
options.thesis: One cell mask where unlit segments are designed too.
options.case: Fuses poorly: scoreboard language implies scores.
options.kept: Absence drawn as deliberately as presence.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.thesis: One alert colour reserved for change.
options.viewport: Today's practice as a boarding pass.
options.case: Fuses poorly: transit urgency is the opposite of the practice.
options.kept: One colour reserved for one meaning.

options.label: Botanical Season Folio
options.thesis: Fixed-scale plates that make change over time comparable.
options.viewport: Five plates, one per concept, on a shared baseline.
options.case: Fuses on Patterns-over-time, but it's a generic natural-history look with no link to practice.
options.kept: Same scale and baseline across all five diagrams.
options.risk: Cream editorial register, a common default.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A calm wellness-app landing page, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, store badges and a phone screenshot, then feature rows.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Calm, Headspace and every habit app, by design.
